ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark pixels with sparse high-intensity (white/light-gray) clusters; ratio heavily skewed toward dark values (~90-95% dark).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark-gray base with high-contrast white linear streaks and irregular blobs (scarring) scattered across both lobes; highest density of white pixel clusters found at the distal tips and right lobe interior.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central notch with a sharp convergence and a deep vertical bounding-box depth relative to fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular high-amplitude serrations; left lobe (viewer perspective) displays large-scale missing tissue/deep indentations; right lobe displays smaller, high-frequency sawtooth-like variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curve along the upper trailing edge, sweeping upward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular/cylindrical pixel clusters concentrated at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, high-contrast linear and curvilinear streaks (rake marks) breaking the dark pigmentation across the entire visible surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notches and structural deformation along the trailing edge of the left lobe; heavy surface scarring and focal barnacle growth at both tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Large-scale jagged indentation on the left lobe trailing edge that breaks the typical lobe symmetry.
